title: Duel Decks: Venser vs. Koth: card flavor text

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A planeswalker and mage of molten earth who teaches that magma takes shape only when infused with one's own rage.

entities.name: Olka
entities.description: A witch who collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets, until she learned to vanish with a thought.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A crew member of the Weatherlight who compares a sky spirit to a strain of music.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship with which Mirri is associated.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: A teacher who gave two wide-eyed brothers a lesson on raw elemental magic.

entities.name: Jedit
entities.description: A cat warrior whose example helped scattered cat warriors survive the ravages of apocalypse after Efrava was destroyed.

entities.name: Efrava
entities.description: The homeland of the cat warriors, which was destroyed.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane across which the cat warriors scattered after Efrava's destruction.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A great power; there may exist powers even greater.

entities.name: Ganedor
entities.description: A loxodon mystic who calls for no half measures and no regrets.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A master wizard who wishes an angel's wings could shelter everyone.

entities.name: Maggath
entities.description: A Sardian elementalist who tried to instill a guard dog's loyalty in a fiery hellhound.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: A figure with many followers; even the volcano is said to do his bidding.

entities.name: Zakken
entities.description: An Enclave cleric who speaks of Cosi's followers.

entities.name: Enclave
entities.description: An order to which the cleric Zakken belongs.

entities.name: Tala Vertan
entities.description: A Makindi shieldmate who tells a pontificating mage to stop talking.

entities.name: Makindi
entities.description: The place from which Tala Vertan, a shieldmate, comes.

entities.name: Jestus Dreya
entities.description: The author of Of Elements and Eternity, who compares implacable earth to a sullen child.

entities.name: Of Elements and Eternity
entities.description: A written work by Jestus Dreya on the elements.

entities.name: Noboru
entities.description: A master kitemaker who speaks of the infinite possibilities seen from the clouds.

entities.name: Kezim
entities.description: A prodigal pyromancer who says the mountains reward those who adapt and end those who fight them.

entities.name: Frek
entities.description: A goblin who remembered only 2,070 of the 2,071 goblin survival tips.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A people with no concept of exploration, who return to forgotten homelands and send thopter kites to scout the land.

entities.name: Ghitu
entities.description: A people known from a proverb about not judging a lizard by its size.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: A people whose sorcerers train by leaping into electrified storm clouds.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A land whose mages long failed to understand the purpose of two rings of the armillary sphere.

entities.name: Agaran language
entities.description: A language that a scroll thief learned to decode.

entities.name: Saltfield nomads
entities.description: Nomads who call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

events.summary: Olka studies the evening mist for years and, upon learning its essence, gains the power to vanish with a thought.
events.quote: Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

events.summary: Tocasia brushes gears and cogs off a table and begins teaching two brothers about raw elemental magic.
events.quote: There, before two wide-eyed brothers, she began a lesson on raw elemental magic.

events.summary: After Efrava is destroyed, its cat warriors scatter across Dominaria; those who follow Jedit's example survive the apocalypse.
events.quote: After Efrava was destroyed, the cat warriors scattered across Dominaria.

events.summary: Frek forgets one of the 2,071 goblin survival tips.

relations.note: Mirri is identified as being of the Weatherlight.
Tala Vertan is a Makindi shieldmate.
Jestus Dreya is the author of the work.
